reviews.comment: She is a great Professor. She gives challenging projects, but if you do them sincerely, you get to learn the topic very well. Her classes are boring and monotonous sometimes, but at the end, you get a better understanding of the subject. She graded leniently on the basis of overall performance in the course.

I found her and her lectures to be more personable and engaging than the average professor. The content is difficult and her HW & exams were even more difficult. I feel like I'm walking out with a decent understanding of the material, but my low grade doesn't necessarily reflect that. She's cool but, again, I'm definitely not a fan of her exams.

CVEN444 is a very difficult class, but Dr. Hueste was kind and made this course as straight forward as possible. Assignments are long, but they help you understand the concepts. Exam questions always felt fair and could be solved using the same steps that Dr. Hueste covers in class. Takes notes as she goes over example problems and you'll do well.

Dr. Hueste is ok. Her lectures are pretty dry and boring, but there's only so much one can do to make concrete design interesting.  Concrete is just a challenging and boring class. Some of the HWs could be a bit long, but her exams were pretty fair.

The class itself is well structured and generally fair. It's Dr Hueste I have an issue with. I went to office hours and she seemed annoyed and was extremely unhelpful. She obviously showed she cares more about her research and lecture events than students. I can understand a band teacher but one who doesn't want to teach has no place here.
